# Version 4.152.4 (Unreleased)
> **Failed-flush cache fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.4 incorporates an upstream Skia fix for stale cache entries after failed GPU flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed GPU flushes no longer retain stale cache entries** — Adopts the upstream m152 cache fix so subsequent Ganesh rendering work does not reuse entries left stale by a failed flush. ([#5287](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5287))
